deviations.topic: arc-23 mount points created by this pack instead of pre-existing
deviations.detail: crates/enforcer-install/src/adapters.rs and src/emitters.rs (the pub-mod barrels) and the two `pub mod adapters;`/`pub mod doctor;`/`pub mod emitters;` lines in src/lib.rs did not exist yet -- arc-23's skeleton documented the mount points but had not created them. Created as minimal additive `pub mod` declaration lists (not `pub use` re-export barrels, so [workspace.lints] `pub use` barrel restriction is not triggered). Follows the same fallback precedent c02 used for HarnessId (crate-local, flagged, promotable later).

The workpack binds the generic adapter's mcpServers key to the x01 SERVER_NAME const ('never a hardcoded literal'). x01 has already landed (crates/enforcer-mcp/src/name.rs, SERVER_NAME = "enforcer"). Cargo.toml is not in c07's owns: line (arc-23 owns crate structure), but the dependency is additive, one line, and non-conflicting -- enforcer-mcp does not depend on enforcer-install, so no cycle. Flagged for the orchestrator/hub to fold into arc-23's own Cargo.toml pass if preferred.

deviations.topic: reference adapters/github-actions/*.yml and adapters/{git-hooks,husky,lefthook}/* templates predate the x01 neutral rename
deviations.detail: The five bundled GitHub Actions workflow templates and the three hook-flavor templates under adapters/ in this repo still say 'ocentra-enforcer' (npm package name, CLI invocation, env var prefixes) -- they were authored before x01's binary/product rename to 'enforcer' landed. This workpack's golden-bytes contract is 'match the bundled adapters/*.yml templates byte-for-byte', so the emitters embed and emit these templates verbatim (including the pre-rename literal) rather than silently rewriting their contents, which would violate the golden-bytes contract this workpack is scoped to. Flagged as a follow-up for whichever pack owns the x01-cutover content edit of these bundled template files (not in c07's owns: line).
